say: This is Unmask. The landing page makes the promise: bid blind, win fair, check everything. And right below, the same eleven bids on two launches: bots win a first-come launch, and win nothing on a sealed one.
Next, the launches list. Each card shows the token, the window, and one number: how many sealed bids. Nothing about who bid, or how much.

To create a launch, you set the token name and symbol, the supply, the reserve price, the bidding window, and a cap per account. The preview updates as you type. Once it is live, nobody can change the rules. Here the demo wallet is on, so nothing is deployed. Creating for real needs a signed-in wallet.

Now an open launch, and the bid form. Pick a limit price and a size. Optionally let an agent bid inside rules you set. Send refunds to another chain, with the address checked as you type. Or get a live price from NEAR Intents to pay from another chain. The seal button needs a real signed-in wallet, so with the demo wallet it stays off.

Now bids from other buyers. Each one is sealed in their browser and sent through the real API. All you see is the count going up: eleven, twelve, fourteen. Not who, not how much, until the window closes.
My bids shows what you locked, what you won, and what came back. With the demo wallet this is sample data, and the page says so.

When the window closes, the creator settles. For this recording the wallet sign-in is skipped, and the same settle route runs. The engine opens the bids and finds one price: three cents for everyone, one million tokens sold, two bids left out with reasons, and a plan for where each refund goes.
Then verify. The page recomputes the result in your browser. Four checks pass. Two say not checked, the code and the hardware attestation, because we cannot check those from here.
The compare page is a playground. Add more bots, or let them bid higher, and watch who ends up with the tokens on a first-come launch and on a sealed one.

cap: How it works, FAQ and limits
say: There is a how-it-works page, a page for creators, a FAQ, and an honest limits page: what this does, and what it does not. The enclave and the payment checks are stand-ins, nothing is attested, and no funds move.

title: Unmask
sub: Bid blind. Win fair. Check everything.
say: That is the flow: create, bid, watch the sealed count, settle, and verify. Thank you.
